orders.title: How to order tests

steps.1: Tap "New test order" and find the patient.
steps.2: Tick the tests (search by name or code).
steps.3: Add the referring doctor if any.
steps.4: "Order and bill" puts the tests on the patient's bill; take the money there.

tips.1: Scan a tube's barcode in the box above to open its order.

orders.settings: Report times and number prefixes are in the Diagnostics settings.

bench.title: How to take samples, enter and verify results

steps.1: "Take samples", then print the labels and stick them on the tubes.
steps.2: Scan the tube and type each value; out-of-range values are flagged when saved.
steps.3: Someone else opens it and taps "Verify and sign" (or "Send back").
steps.4: When every test is verified, print the report and mark it given.

tips.1: A change after signing is a new correction; the old values stay on record.

mistakes.1: Check the patient's name before sticking a label.
mistakes.2: A clotted or too-small sample: "Reject sample" and take a new one.

parameters.title: How to set up a test's values

steps.2: Add each value with its unit.
steps.3: Add normal ranges by sex and age (newborns in days).

tips.1: The sample ranges given are a start: your pathologist checks them.

steps.1: Give each doctor their percent on their record (blank = the usual percent in the rules).
steps.2: Commission is counted by itself when the patient's bill is final.
steps.3: At month end open the doctor, check the orders and "Record a payment".
steps.4: A mistake? "Take back" that order's line with a reason.

tips.1: Nothing is deleted: a taken-back line and every payment stay on record, and go into the books when Accounting is on.
